title: 长颈鹿的脖子
subtitle: 和我们一样只有七块骨头
character: wearing a mustard yellow t-shirt, navy blue shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, coloured pencil drawing with visible pencil strokes and layered hatching, warm ochre, savanna gold and dusty brown

pages.zh:
长颈鹿走过来了。
我把头仰到最后，
才看见它的脸。
它就站在那儿，
比一层楼还高。
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up at a zoo tilting his head far back, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural, amazed; behind him the long neck and small head of a giraffe rise high above him.

pages.zh:
它光是一个脖子，
就有两米多长。
比爸爸站着还高，
比我高出两个头。
身子还在下面呢。

这么长的脖子，
是用来吃饭的。
高树顶上的叶子，
别的动物够不着，
它一伸头就咬到。
pages.scene: One single giraffe stretching its head up into the top of a tall thorn tree on a cream background, its long tongue reaching out for the leaves. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
最奇怪的是骨头。
你摸摸自己的脖子，
里面有七块骨头。
长颈鹿的脖子里，
也正好是七块。

它不是多长了骨头，
是每一块都被拉长了。
它的一块颈椎骨，
差不多有我的
一条胳膊那么长。

头举得那么高，
血怎么送上去呢？
它的心脏特别有力，
有二十多斤重，
墙一样厚的肌肉。
pages.scene: One single real heart organ of dark red muscle with very thick walls, cut open to show the deep hollow chamber inside, an anatomical organ and not a heart symbol, no animal in the picture, on a cream background. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
心脏一下一下地跳，
把血往上顶两米高。
这股劲比我们的
要大上两三倍，
不然血就上不去。

喝水的时候才麻烦。
它得把两条前腿
向两边劈得很开，
脖子一路低下去，
嘴才够得着水。
pages.scene: One single giraffe drinking at a water hole on a cream background, its two front legs splayed wide apart and its head lowered right down to the water. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
头一下子低到地上，
血不会冲坏脑子吗？
脖子里有一道道瓣膜，
像一扇扇小门，
把血挡住慢慢放。

等它抬起头来，
小门再打开，
血慢慢流回去。
所以它喝完水，
站起来也不会晕。
pages.scene: One single giraffe lifting its head up from the water on a cream background, drops of water falling from its mouth. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
两只公长颈鹿打架，
不用嘴也不用腿，
就甩起长脖子，
互相撞过去，
咚的一声，很响。
pages.scene: Two male giraffes standing side by side on a cream background, swinging their long necks to strike each other. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
回家的路上我想，
它的脖子那么长，
骨头却和我一样多，
只有七块，
只是每一块都长。
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up walking home with one hand resting on the back of his own neck, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural, thoughtful.
